demos.title: use cache and the static shell
demos.summary: One page, two timestamps: a component cached with 'use cache' is prerendered into the static shell at build time, while one behind connection() and Suspense renders on every request.

demos.title: Measure page speed
demos.summary: TTFB, LCP, CLS and load time read from the browser's own Performance APIs on this page, with a late banner that raises CLS and a late hero that moves LCP.

demos.title: use cache: keys, lifetime and updateTag
demos.summary: Two cities, one cached function: 'use cache' keys the entry by its argument, cacheLife('hours') keeps it, and updateTag in a Server Action clears just one city.

demos.title: What reaches the browser
demos.summary: A Server Component that signs a value with a key that never leaves the server, next to a use client counter that holds a Server Component as children: click, reload, and see which part runs where.
